snippet.title: Lucas the Game by Timothy Courtney (OFFICIAL TRAILER)
snippet.description:
Download the free-to-play action platformer Lucas the Game on Windows, Mac, & Linux: https://timothycourtneymedia.com/video-games/lucas-the-game.html 

🎮 Play as Lucas, a lovable character who must save the world. Prepare to be challenged like you've never been challenged before. You'll be surprised by unique worlds like you've never seen and have some great laughs along the way at the quirky humor. 

🔮 Featured in the Groupees 'Psychic Pixel Party Bundle', with several other great games including Synonymy (Narrated by Richard Dawkins), and an independent documentary called Pixel Poetry: A Film About Games, Art, Society, and Culture.

🎉 Lucas the Game is a puzzle-platformer published on July 1, 2015. It features a dedicated chiptune soundtrack by Matt Clark, a member of Ola Podrida. All of Lucas the Game's art was made by Timothy Courtney using GIMP, a first for a published video game.

Game contains mature humor.
